name: One for the World
summary: Asks students and young professionals to take the 1% Pledge, giving 1% of their income to charities GiveWell recommends, through chapters at universities and graduate schools and talks at companies in the US, UK, Canada and Australia. It moved about $1.55 million in its year to June 2024, with a sister charity in the UK.

spending.source: https://1fortheworld.org/api/media/file/FY24-Audit-Final-Financial-Statements.pdf (One for the World, Inc., audited financial statements, year ended 30 June 2024: total expenses $1,442,179, of which grants to charities $684,439 are donors' money passed on and $40,148 donated legal services; own cash costs $717,592); One For The World (UK charity 1193383), accounts for the year ended 30 June 2024: expenditure £71,630, of which £39,928 granted to charities, own costs £31,702 (about $40,483 at the IRS's 2024 average of $1.277 per pound). Both entities' own costs: about $758,000.

lines.label: Effective giving: the 1% Pledge, university and graduate chapters, corporate talks, the donation platform
lines.source: https://1fortheworld.org/api/media/file/FY24-Audit-Final-Financial-Statements.pdf (Note 1: its programme services are organising student volunteers and giving talks at companies to promote effective giving; one programme, and its impact report counts every cost against the money it moves)
